sentences.text: Sri K. Madhava Reddy, learned Standing Counsel for GVMC takes notice for respondent Nos.2, 4 and 5.
Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Medical, Health and Family Welfare takes notice for respondent No.3 and requests time to file counter-affidavit.
Print the name of Sri K. Madhava Reddy, learned Standing Counsel for respondent Nos.2, 4 and 5.
List the matter after two weeks along with W.P.No.29215 of 2022.
CMR, J

Pursuant to the notification issued calling for tenders for allotment of the work of collection and transportation of waste from chicken, mutton and beaf stalls and dumping it into Kapuluppada dumping yard, the petitioner has participated in the said tender process and became successful bidder.
Accordingly, Work Order was issued to the petitioner on Nil.04.2022.
As per the said Work Order, the said work was allotted till the year 2024.
While so, earlier an order was passed by the GVMC authorities cancelling the said Work Order by pointing out certain violations.
The petitioner challenged the said order before this Court in W.P.No.29215 of 2022.

In the said Writ Petition, this Court issued an interim direction, dated 14.09.2022, stating that no new tenders should be invited for the same work and it shall be open to the Commissioner to consider the reply,
dated 05.09.2022, of the petitioner and pass appropriate orders after providing an opportunity to the petitioner.
Pursuant to the said direction, an order, dated 10.11.2022, was passed by the Commissioner of the Corporation.
As per the said order, the said work was again entrusted to the petitioner.
Accordingly, the petitioner has been carrying on the said work as per the said order.

Now again the impugned order, dated 27.01.2023, was issued by the Commissioner of GVMC cancelling the said contract or work allotted to the petitioner on the ground that the petitioner has Sri Vaisakhi vs State Of Andhra Pradesh on 17 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2351024/
1 been unauthorizedly transporting the said waste material of chicken, mutton, etc., in three vehicles and the same is hazardous to the safety of the health of the public under Section 15 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The petitioner challenges the impugned order again on the ground that the said order was passed without providing an opportunity to the petitioner of hearing or without calling for the explanation of the petitioner and that the same is contrary to the earlier interim direction given by this Court.

Therefore, as the very validity of the said cancellation of the work is challenged on various grounds including violation of principles of natural justice, the validity of the said order is to be decided after the respondents file their counter justifying their action in cancelling the said Work Order.
Therefore, in the said facts and circumstances of the case, there shall be interim suspension of the impugned proceedings, dated 27.01.2023, till the next date of hearing.
The 2nd respondent shall permit the petitioner to continue to undertake the entrusted work, till the next date of hearing.
The 2nd respondent shall not call for any fresh tenders also till the next date of hearing.
